cases.about: Beth was a  Registered Nurse Supervisor at Children's ER at HonorHealth Deer Valley Medical Center. Beth was also a Realtor at DPR Realty. Her Go Fund Me said, "The world lost a truly selfless and kind woman, who embodied the very essence of compassion and generosity. Beth was a daughter, mother, and grandmother. Her positive energy and caring nature touched the lives of everyone she encountered. Her children and grandchild were the lights of her life and she was incredibly proud of their accomplishments!"
